title: Units of measurement and money in school mathematics across 10 countries
description: Units of measurement and money in the school mathematics of 10 countries (Austria, France, Germany, Italy, the Netherlands, Poland, Spain, Switzerland, the United Kingdom, the United States): measurement systems, whether the decagram and the are/hectare are school units, imperial and customary units, unit symbols used in word problems, and money - currency symbol and its position, minor unit, coins and banknotes - with the curriculum documents each value was read from. Prepared by Imaginesis (https://imaginesis.com), a maths worksheet generator.
